newsitem.title: CHINA: HK gold ends down on overseas selling in quiet day.
newsitem.headline: HK gold ends down on overseas selling in quiet day.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended down on Tuesday from New York's previous close on overseas selling during a very quiet day, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$318.80/319.30 per ounce compared to New York's close at US$319.70/320.20 on Monday.
Traders reported sales from Australia at the $319.50 level.
There had been very little buying interest in the market, they said.
Gold fell further in afternoon trade when European markets opened, dealers said.
Sentiment was still weak and traders saw support levels at between $315 and $317.
Physical demand had been relatively weak as buyers expected further drops, dealers said.
"There's not much buying interest, even at these low levels," said one trader.
Local tael gold ended HK$24 down at HK$2,957 per tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society remained unchanged from its previous fix at nil.
